description: This file contains the implementation of OpenTelemetry tracing spans, including interfaces for read-only and read-write spans, the 'recordingSpan' struct implementing span behavior, span lifecycle methods, attribute management, and span context handling.

classes.name: recordingSpan
classes.description: Implementation of a sampled span with lifecycle, attribute, event, link, and context management.

classes.name: nonRecordingSpan
classes.description: Minimal span implementation that wraps a SpanContext, does not record data.

methods.name: IsRecording
methods.description: Indicates if the span is being recorded.

methods.name: SetStatus
methods.description: Sets the span's status with code and description.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Ends the span, recording end time and processing.

methods.name: RecordError
methods.description: Records an error as an event on the span.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: Adds an event to the span.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the span.

methods.name: EndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the span.

methods.name: Resource
methods.description: Returns the resource associated with the span.

methods.name: AddLink
methods.description: Adds a link to the span.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a read-only snapshot of the span.

methods.name: private
methods.description: Private method to prevent external implementation.

methods.name: runtimeTrace
methods.description: Starts a runtime/trace task for the span.
